_comment: Corrections to the source documents themselves, issued by the data owner. These are NOT modelling choices and NOT tuned against ground truth: each records a figure the document prints wrongly, the value the owner states is correct, and who said so. Applied after extraction and only when the extracted value still matches `from`, so a corrected document re-reads cleanly instead of being double-patched.

corrections.reason: Typo in the loan agreement: 3a4aa2dbd6c4.pdf (ACC-7804) prints clause 6.3 as 0.04x of revenue; the organizers confirmed the agreement loaded incorrectly and the threshold is 0.045x, with the answer key holding the correct value.
